datasets.name: Google Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0, validation split: beat, 4-4, 15-60 s (beat-phase validation, not scored)
datasets.attribution: Gillick, Roberts, Engel, Eck, Bamman. Learning to Groove with Inverse Sequence Transformations. ICML 2019.
datasets.use: T19a beat-phase validation outside the scored BEAT-P02 test subset; fetched by prepare.py groove-lock (HTTP Range members)

datasets.name: LibriSpeech test-clean: first utterance of each of the first ten lexically sorted speakers
datasets.attribution: Panayotov, Chen, Povey, Khudanpur. LibriSpeech. ICASSP 2015. OpenSLR SLR12.
datasets.use: T19a independent read-speech WER, ten speakers; deterministic subset, not a full test-clean score

datasets.name: AMI Meeting Corpus EN2001a: headset mix and manual annotations v1.6.2 (words, segments)
datasets.attribution: Carletta et al. The AMI Meeting Corpus: A Pre-announcement. MLMI 2005. AMI Consortium, University of Edinburgh.
datasets.use: TR-P06 (D28, T19q): the 120 s excerpt chosen by T19's pre-registered rule (EN2001a 0-120 s) is pooled with the corpus clips in the gated row "TR-P06 pooled with AMI" and scored alone in "TR-P06 EN2001a-0s-120s" (per-clip rule); T19 registered it for the report-only row "TR-P06 human-labelled (report-only)" (Q7), which D28 replaced; no tuning

datasets.name: AMI Meeting Corpus ES2002a, IS1000a, TS3003a, IB4001, IN1001: headset mixes and their manual words and segments (annotations v1.6.2, extracted from the zip in T19-AMI-report-only)
datasets.attribution: Carletta et al. The AMI Meeting Corpus: A Pre-announcement. MLMI 2005. AMI Consortium, University of Edinburgh.
datasets.use: T19q round S validation set V-AMI (pre-registered 3 Nov 02:23): the first meeting of each series ES, IS, TS, IB, IN sharing no participant with EN2001a, up to three 120 s excerpts each by T19's window rule; validation only, feeds no scored row; no tuning

datasets.name: Tears of Steel 05:54-07:13 dialogue cut (tos-dialogue-79s) with its OT-2 aligned words and OT-1 speaker consensus, frozen 2 Nov 2026 06:02
datasets.use: T19 rows "TR-P06 tos-dialogue-79s" and "TR-P06 pooled incl. dialogue cut" (Q1; reported, not gated since D28): cut by ffmpeg from the source, labelled by T00's OT-2/OT-1 code unchanged before any diarization candidate ran; derivation in the T19 notes (log 05:45-06:02); no tuning

datasets.name: Tears of Steel official English subtitles, corrected against the audio and force-aligned
datasets.use: T19 transcript WER and word timing on the two corpus cut ranges

datasets.name: Speaker reference: consensus of two independent diarisation pipelines (CAM++, ERes2Net)
datasets.url: derived from the corpus clips by datasets/prepare-speakers.py
datasets.use: T19 diarisation agreement on the two corpus cut ranges

datasets.name: Google Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0, three released test performances (audio + MIDI + metronome grid)
datasets.attribution: Gillick, Roberts, Engel, Eck, Bamman. Learning to Groove with Inverse Sequence Transformations. ICML 2019.
datasets.use: T19 beat F-measure on annotated real music (±70 ms)

datasets.name: LibriSpeech test-clean
datasets.attribution: Panayotov, Chen, Povey, Khudanpur. LibriSpeech. ICASSP 2015. OpenSLR SLR12.
datasets.use: T19 WER on read speech; downloaded and verified by the T19 run (346 MB)

datasets.name: GeoNames cities15000 + countryInfo (offline reverse geocoder)
datasets.use: T14 Library location filter: GPS → "city, country" (datasets/prepare-geonames.py builds the bundle)

datasets.name: BeatThis 8-fold cross-validation split of the Groove MIDI Dataset (CPJKU/beat_this_annotations groove_midi/8-folds.split)
datasets.attribution: Foscarin, Schlüter, Widmer. Beat this! Accurate beat tracking without DBN postprocessing. ISMIR 2024. Annotations: Institute of Computational Perception, JKU Linz.
datasets.use: T19q round B4 (pre-registered 3 Nov 05:11): maps each Groove validation performance to the BeatThis fold checkpoint that held it out; the scorer checks the map against the pre-registered fold list; validation only, feeds no scored row; no tuning

models.name: onnx-community/pyannote-segmentation-3.0
models.use: T19a local vad engine; independent of OT-1 embedding networks and OT-2 CTC aligner

models.name: onnx-community/whisper-small_timestamped
models.use: T19a local whisper engine; independent of OT-1 embedding networks and OT-2 CTC aligner

models.name: onnx-community/Florence-2-base-ft
models.use: T19a local vision engine; independent of OT-1 embedding networks and OT-2 CTC aligner

models.name: Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
models.use: T19a local embedding engine; independent of OT-1 embedding networks and OT-2 CTC aligner

models.name: Xenova/clip-vit-base-patch32
models.use: T19q round F8 local visual search channel (T19's F2): one CLIP image embedding per description segment (its first frame) and one CLIP text embedding of 'a photo of {query}.' per query

models.name: Xenova/ast-finetuned-audioset-10-10-0.4593
models.use: T19a local sound engine; independent of OT-1 embedding networks and OT-2 CTC aligner

models.name: onnx-community/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-english-ONNX
models.use: T19a local CTC word aligner (TR-P03 new-model round). Same family as the OT-2 timing oracle (wav2vec2 CTC, 20 ms frames) but a different checkpoint and training data: XLSR-53 fine-tuned on CommonVoice 6.0 English. Base BeebekBhz/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-english @ 6c6898b7 (Apache-2.0), a copy of jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-english

models.name: onnx-community/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM
models.attribution: Wang, Liang, Wang, Chen, Zhang, Xiang, Deng, Qian. Wespeaker: A research and production oriented speaker embedding learning toolkit. ICASSP 2023. Pretrained wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM (WeNet, trained on VoxCeleb), via pyannote/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM, ONNX export by onnx-community.
models.use: T19q round S2 local speaker embedder (replaced T19a-speaker): one 256-d WeSpeaker ResNet34 vector per transcript segment, clustered offline with average linkage at cosine distance .60

models.name: OpenAI Whisper large-v3-turbo, sherpa-onnx ONNX export (OT-2 second audio check)
3D-Speaker CAM++ and ERes2Net English VoxCeleb, sherpa-onnx ONNX exports (OT-1 pipelines)
CPJKU/beat_this fold0 (ONNX export of 8-fold cross-validation checkpoint 0)
models.attribution: Foscarin, Schlüter, Widmer. Beat this! Accurate beat tracking without DBN postprocessing. ISMIR 2024.
models.use: T19q round B4 learned beat tracker for dense music (BEAT-P02). Fold 0 of BeatThis's own 8-fold split never trained on the scored take drummer1/eval_session/1; it did train on the other two scored Groove takes and on the Groove validation items outside fold 0 (see notes)
